content_zh:
众生还没有从早上激烈角逐的状态中脱离出来, 满身的疲惫困倦。这样一看, 精神最饱满的竟然是连胜。
付教官负手站在排前, 看着众人道：“今天没有规定的路线, 随意选择山上的位置开始跑动。每个人带上记录仪, 运动量不跑够今天不能休息！跑不完就不要睡觉！”
众生抬头应道：“是！”
今天太阳有些猛烈, 他们站在日头下面, 汗涔涔的下。
按照以往的经验来看，要是想在八点前结束，那么除去半小时的吃饭时间, 基本没有可以休息的空隙。就算是吃饭，也不能停下自己的脚步。
女生稍稍好一些，但也不容乐观。
军事学院女生不多, 仅有的几位, 大部分得到了同学的救济，免除了这次越野惩罚。
连胜等人显得尤为可怜。
付教官走了两步, 抬起下巴道：“在这里要表扬一位同学, 孟江武同学。他在上交猎物之后, 依旧选择参加这次越野跑。这在指挥系里是非常难得的, 我希望大家都能向他学习！”
他话音一落, 周围人大喊可惜。
“不要可以给我啊！干嘛这么浪费！”
“早上拼死拼活是为了什么？你还跟我抢的差点兄弟反目, 就为了参加越野跑？！”
郑磊也是大惊，扭过头问：“你什么情况啊？”
孟江武咳了一声，继续站着。
付教官大喝一声：“都给我安静！”
付教官声音冷下来道：“你们还不知道演习的目的是什么吗？是为了积累经验锻炼自身！你们已经是半个军人, 都给我有点觉悟！如果为了休息, 为了逃避，勉强敷衍的过来这里，趁早给我滚！”
众生垂下视线，站正沉默。
付教官着重指了指连胜的方向，虽然没有说出来，但是意思非常明确。
丫一看就知道早上在偷懒，严重打乱了他们训练的节奏。这不符合他们的环节安排。
付教官看向坐在营地旁边休息的一群胜利者们，问道：“有没有人也想来参加的？”

众生迅速摇头。
付教官咋舌一声，转回来说道：“现在开始，所有人去佩戴统计器。我们依旧在营地这里等候。禁止一切作弊行为，违者严重处置。不要小看你们的教官，明白了吗？”
众生：“明白！”
付教官抬手一挥：“上！”
众人四散开，过去物资点那边领取统计器，别到胸口，然后往山上跑去。
孟江武走到连胜旁边，装作不经意的提醒道：“在山腰附近的地方，有一块平地，那里比较好跑，我们一般都是去那里。你知道的吧？”
连胜看他一眼：“他们都在那里？”
孟江武：“差不多吧。反正人很多。”
二人慢慢跑动起来，朝着山上跑去。郑磊和沈喻从他们身边路过，朝他们挥挥手，然后先走一步。
连胜问道：“你为什么突然又决定来参加了越野了？”
孟江武抬起头骄傲道：“为了积累经验锻炼自身！”
连胜淡淡道：“哦……”
孟江武：“……”
孟江武看她表情，一时很不爽：“你这是什么意思？觉得我是在骗你吗？”
连胜却好像没听到，忽然转了话题说：“你来参加，付教官非常高兴。”
孟江武：“啊？”
连胜放缓了速度，靠着小道的边缘走。孟江武跟着慢了下来。
“我说付教官今天很奇怪。”连胜说，“既然狩猎的奖惩是他们制定的规则，那么规则以内的事情，他们不应该干涉。他今天却主动鼓励你们参加了。”
孟江武觉得简直莫名其妙：“老师总喜欢好学的学生吧。这有什么奇怪的？”
连胜说：“不。如果休息算是一种奖励的话，他不仅夸奖主动放弃奖励的人，甚至鼓动其他人也去放弃奖励，这是一种非常错误的行为。甚至会打击之后的积极性，造成胜利者的不平衡。那不如，取消这个机制，用积分做奖励。”

孟江武深感无语道：“你想太多了吧。”
连胜两手插兜，又偏过头，面无表情的看了他一眼。
孟江武觉得头皮都有些发麻，说道：“你多熟悉一下山林地形倒是挺好的，因为之后就是个人实战和小组实战了。”
“哦。”连胜点点头，“我明白了。”
孟江武听得都有些急了：“你到底是明白什么啊？！”
连胜说：“第一天越野跑，带我们了解山里的地形，之后就开始狩猎活动。第一次狩猎的数目越多，第二次的难度就越大。虽然我只参加的几天，但我觉得整个演习的过程已经相对完善。我并不认为演习的每一天应该分开看待。”

content_en:
All living beings have not yet emerged from the fierce competition in the morning, and are full of fatigue and sleepiness. Looking at it this way, the one who is most energetic is actually the winning streak.
Instructor Fu stood in front of the row with his hands behind his hands, looking at the crowd and saying: "There is no prescribed route today, just randomly choose a location on the mountain to start running. Everyone brings a recorder. If you don't run enough exercise, you can't rest today! Don't sleep until you finish running!"
All sentient beings raised their heads and responded: "Yes!"
The sun was quite strong today, and they stood under it, dripping with sweat.
According to past experience, if you want to finish before eight o'clock, then except for the half-hour meal time, there is basically no gap for rest. Even if he is eating, he cannot stop himself.
Girls are slightly better off, but not optimistic either.
There are not many female students in the Military Academy, and most of the few who did get relief from their classmates were exempted from the cross-country punishment.
Lian Sheng and others seemed particularly pitiful.
Instructor Fu took two steps, raised his chin and said, "I would like to praise a classmate here, Meng Jiangwu. After turning in his prey, he still chose to participate in this cross-country run. This is very rare in the command system. I hope everyone can learn from him!"
As soon as he finished speaking, the people around him shouted that it was a pity.
"You can give it to me if you don't want it! Why waste it so much!"
"What are you working so hard for this morning? You almost turned against me because of your rivalry, just to participate in cross-country running?!"
Zheng Lei was also shocked, turned around and asked, "What's going on with you?"
Meng Jiangwu coughed and continued to stand.
Instructor Fu shouted: "Quiet!"
Instructor Fu's voice cooled down and he said, "Don't you know what the purpose of the exercise is? It's to accumulate experience and train yourself! You are already half a soldier, so you have to wake up a little! If you come here reluctantly to rest or escape, get out of here as soon as possible!"
All living beings lowered their gazes and stood silent.
Instructor Fu pointed emphatically in the direction of the winning streak. Although he didn't say it out loud, his meaning was very clear.
At a glance, Ya knew that he was slacking off in the morning, which seriously disrupted the rhythm of their training. This doesn't fit into their schedule.
Instructor Fu looked at the group of winners sitting next to the camp and asked, "Is there anyone who wants to participate?"
Everyone shook their heads quickly.
Instructor Fu sighed, then turned back and said: "From now on, everyone is going to wear the statistics device. We are still waiting here in the camp. All cheating is prohibited, and violators will be severely punished. Don't underestimate your instructor, do you understand?"
Sentient beings: "Understood!"
Instructor Fu raised his hand and waved: "Go!"
Everyone dispersed, went to the supply point to receive the statistics device, stuck it on their chest, and then ran up the mountain.
Meng Jiangwu walked to Liansheng and reminded him casually: "There is a flat land near the mountainside. It is easier to run there. We usually go there. You know, right?"
Lian Sheng glanced at him: "Where are they?"
Meng Jiangwu: "Absolutely. There are a lot of people anyway."
The two of them started running slowly towards the mountain. Zheng Lei and Shen Yu passed by them, waved to them, and took a step forward.
Lian Sheng asked: "Why did you suddenly decide to participate in cross-country again?"
Meng Jiangwu raised his head and said proudly: "To accumulate experience and train yourself!"
Lian Sheng said lightly: "Oh..."
Meng Jiangwu: "..."
Meng Jiangwu looked at her expression and was very unhappy for a moment: "What do you mean? Do you think I am lying to you?"
Lian Sheng didn't seem to hear it, and suddenly changed the subject and said, "Instructor Fu is very happy that you came to participate."
Meng Jiangwu: "Ah?"
Streak slowed down and walked along the edge of the trail. Meng Jiangwu slowed down.
"I said Instructor Fu was very strange today." Lian Sheng said, "Since the rewards and punishments for hunting are set by them,Rules, then they should not interfere with matters within the rules. Today, he took the initiative to encourage you to participate. "
Meng Jiangwu found it baffling: "Teachers always like students who are eager to learn. What's so strange about this? "
Streak said: “No. If rest is considered a reward, he not only praises those who take the initiative to give up rewards, but even encourages others to give up rewards. This is a very wrong behavior. It may even dampen subsequent enthusiasm and create an imbalance among the winners. It would be better to cancel this mechanism and use points as rewards. "
Meng Jiangwu felt speechless and said: "You think too much. "
Lian Sheng put his hands in his pockets, turned his head again, and gave him an expressionless look.
Meng Jiangwu felt that his scalp was numb and said: "It would be good for you to become more familiar with the mountain and forest terrain, because then there will be individual and group actual combat. "
"oh. "Lian Sheng nodded, "I understand. "
Meng Jiangwu was a little anxious when he heard this: "What on earth do you understand? ! "
Lian Sheng said: “On the first day of cross-country running, we learned about the terrain in the mountains, and then we started hunting. The greater the number on the first hunt, the more difficult it will be on the second. Although I have only participated for a few days, I feel that the entire exercise process has been relatively complete. I don't think each day of the exercise should be looked at separately. "
